items.text: mass number the total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus of an atom

items.label: text
items.text: melting the change of state from a solid to a liquid. It occurs at the melting point

items.label: text
items.text: melting point the temperature at which a substance changes its state from a solid to a liquid. A pure substance has a fixed melting point but a mixture may melt over a range of temperatures

items.text: molar mass the mass of 1 mole of a substance

items.label: text
items.text: particle a small object. In chemistry, particle can be used to refer to atoms, molecules, ions or the subatomic particles, including protons, neutrons and electrons

items.label: text
items.text: period a horizontal row in the Periodic Table. All elements in the same period have the same number of occupied shells

items.label: text
items.text: Periodic Table a table in which elements are arranged in the order of increasing atomic number and in terms of chemical and physical properties
